reply_text:
*One merge-blocking finding* in `access-roles` (`d6780ec`):

• *High — `access/gate.py:4`: legitimate admins loaded from config are denied.* `role is 'admin'` compares object identity, not string value. I reproduced `role_from_config(' ADMIN ')` returning `'admin'`, but `has_access({'role': role}, 'admin-tools')` returning `False`.
  *Recommended fix:* use `role == 'admin'` and add a regression test using a config-loaded role. `tests/test_gate.py::GateTest.test_admin_reaches_admin_tools` only uses a literal, which masks the bug.

All 5 existing tests pass. No other findings. No files changed.
